maktaba.tv: the design, for review

Stories 60.01 and 60.02. 134 renders, English and Arabic: every layout at 360, 768 and 1280 px in dark, with light where the spec asks for it; the tagline heroes at 1280; the social cards at 1200 × 630. Each image opens full size. The spec is design/README.md; the copy is in copy/; the voice guide is copy/voice.md.

Screenshots are stand-ins. Every app screenshot in part B is a devportal Apps screenshot on test data (web/packages/devportal/static/assets/apps/), not a household's library and not drawn. Story 60.09 replaces them with shots of the demo library.

Hidden on purpose. The download page and home show no iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Android or Android TV app and no server-package card: none is publicly installable yet (Q5, A7). The TV is shown through big screen in the desktop apps and the TV's browser; phones and tablets through the browser.

Part B: the direction, the pages and the copy

The tagline

Chosen on 2026-11-12 (Q1), from five proposals per language (copy/README.md lists the others). It fits the social card in three lines or fewer (render.mjs fails otherwise); the home hero and the social card show it in place.
